Moth-Eidol @VERSION@ (Linux x64)

HOW TO RUN
  1. Unzip anywhere you can write.
  2. chmod +x MothEidol   (only if the executable bit was lost), then run ./MothEidol
  Nothing is installed and no root rights are needed. A desktop session with a system tray is required.

YOUR DATA
  Settings, projects and events are stored under ~/.local/share/MothEidol.
  The app only reads your log files, with the permissions of the user running it.
